source: Supplied Switch BOTW base game; no update or DLC
limitations: Shared animations can appear in more than one rig library.
Procedural UMii NPCs are assembly previews; original face generation is incomplete.
Bulk GLBs contain rigs; their animation curves are external JSON.
Only the Bokoblin has a baked, validated Blender scene.
Original shaders, procedural physics, and gameplay state machines are not reproduced.
